snippet.title: Soverain | Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Soverain is live now on Kickstarter :  https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jonathanbrassaud/eternal-legend-0
Wishlist on Steam: https://s.team/a/4123930
Join the community:  https://discord.com/invite/wP6MnCYjJq

Soverain is a 2D turn-based tactical RPG where your choices shape the journey, featuring branching consequences, a rich world, and a memorable cast of characters.
